propositions: Strict eval-spec validation currently lives only in an inline Python step in prompt-eval.yml, which is not referenced by gerrit-verify.yaml and does not gate the Verified vote or block Gerrit submit.

Three plan-review specs (asserted-capability, decomp-shape, necessity) shipped with dataset but no gold_set, merged with Verified +1 while prompt-eval.yml remained red because the validation does not block pre-merge.
The default pytest suite runs in _build-and-test.yml callers and gates Verified; moving strict validation into a unit test there will enforce discipline pre-merge.
A glob-based unit test in test_eval_scorers.py must assert validate_eval_spec(spec) clean for all packaged specs and validate_eval_spec(spec, strict=True) clean for all dataset-bearing specs.
The redundant inline validation step must be removed from prompt-eval.yml after the unit test is added.
